script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       DATE_FORMAT(n.t + INTERVAL 30 MINUTE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_until,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id, j.organization_id, j.command, j.job_status, j.progress_percent, j.progress_message, j.attempt_count,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.next_attempt_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS next_attempt_at, j.lease_owner, DATE_FORMAT(j.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lease_expires_at,
       (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live, (j.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR j.next_attempt_at <= n.t) AS due,
       j.row_version, j.error_code, j.error_message, j.error_details, j.idempotency_key, j.correlation_id, j.is_deleted
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_CCguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.id = {{node:code_node_CCguard.data.jobId}}

SELECT st.step_name, st.step_status FROM gd_publish_step st WHERE st.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_CCguard.data.tenantId}}' AND st.job_id = '{{node:code_node_CCguard.data.jobId}}' AND st.step_name LIKE 'C%' AND st.is_deleted = 0
SELECT j.prepared_payload FROM gd_async_job j WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_CCguard.data.tenantId}}' AND j.id = {{node:code_node_CCguard.data.jobId}}

script.code:
SELECT g.gd_status,
       (SELECT p.result_ref FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND p.job_id = CONCAT('GDC|', SUBSTRING(j.correlation_id, 4)) AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lock_ref
  FROM gd_async_job j
  JOIN goods_delivery g ON g.tenant_id = j.tenant_id AND g.id = CAST(SUBSTRING(j.correlation_id, 4) AS UNSIGNED) AND g.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_CCguard.data.tenantId}}' AND j.id = {{node:code_node_CCguard.data.jobId}} AND j.correlation_id REGEXP '^GD\\|[0-9]{1,20}$'

script.code:
SELECT CAST(pl.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(t.id AS CHAR) AS picking_id, CAST(COALESCE(t.to_id, '') AS CHAR) AS picking_no,
       CAST(COALESCE(pl.gd_id, '') AS CHAR) AS gd_id, CAST(COALESCE(pl.line_status, '') AS CHAR) AS line_status, COALESCE(t.is_processing, 0) AS is_processing,
       TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, t.update_time, CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', '+08:00')) AS lock_age_sec,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gd_async_job j
         WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_CCguard.data.tenantId}}' AND j.command = 'CONFIRM_PICKING' AND j.job_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')
           AND j.is_deleted = 0 AND CAST(j.picking_id AS UNSIGNED) = t.id) AS open_jobs
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT x.transfer_order_id FROM transfer_order_jz8m9w3h_sub x
         WHERE x.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_CCguard.data.tenantId}}' AND x.gd_id = {{node:code_node_CCentry.data.gdId}} AND x.is_deleted = 0 AND COALESCE(x.line_status,
		'') NOT IN ('Completed', 'Cancelled')) o
  STRAIGHT_JOIN transfer_order t ON t.id = o.transfer_order_id AND t.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_CCguard.data.tenantId}}' AND t.is_deleted = 0
   AND COALESCE(t.to_status, '') NOT IN ('Completed', 'Cancelled', 'Draft')
  JOIN transfer_order_jz8m9w3h_sub pl ON pl.transfer_order_id = t.id AND pl.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_CCguard.data.tenantId}}' AND pl.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE '{{node:code_node_CCentry.data.force}}' = 'Yes'
 ORDER BY t.id, pl.id

script.code:
SELECT CAST(pl.id AS CHAR) AS id, CAST(t.id AS CHAR) AS picking_id, CAST(COALESCE(t.to_id, '') AS CHAR) AS picking_no,
       CAST(COALESCE(pl.gd_id, '') AS CHAR) AS gd_id, CAST(COALESCE(pl.line_status, '') AS CHAR) AS line_status, COALESCE(t.is_processing, 0) AS is_processing,
       TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, t.update_time, CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', '+08:00')) AS lock_age_sec,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gd_async_job j
         WHERE j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_CCguard.data.tenantId}}' AND j.command = 'CONFIRM_PICKING' AND j.job_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED')
           AND j.is_deleted = 0 AND CAST(j.picking_id AS UNSIGNED) = t.id) AS open_jobs
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT x.transfer_order_id FROM transfer_order_jz8m9w3h_sub x
         WHERE x.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_CCguard.data.tenantId}}' AND x.gd_id = {{node:code_node_CCentry.data.gdId}} AND x.is_deleted = 0 AND COALESCE(x.line_status,
		'') NOT IN ('Completed', 'Cancelled')) o
  STRAIGHT_JOIN transfer_order t ON t.id = o.transfer_order_id AND t.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_CCguard.data.tenantId}}' AND t.is_deleted = 0
   AND COALESCE(t.to_status, '') NOT IN ('Completed', 'Cancelled', 'Draft')
  JOIN transfer_order_jz8m9w3h_sub pl ON pl.transfer_order_id = t.id AND pl.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_CCguard.data.tenantId}}' AND pl.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE 'Yes' = 'Yes'
 ORDER BY t.id, pl.id
